document_metadata.document_title: iSWM Technical Manual — Site Development Controls (NCTCOG)

design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: Structural controls sized to treat the Water Quality Volume (WQv); primary performance goal approximately 70–80% TSS removal (Primary TSS). Integrated design also addresses streambank protection volume (SPv) and flood control. Controls may be online or offline diverting WQv to treatment.

design_parameters.enrich_notes: NCTCOG iSWM Site Development Controls; WQv sizing referenced but rainfall depth for WQv not stated in excerpts. Bioretention filter drain uses k=0.5 ft/day in examples (not mapped to in/hr field). Pond/wetland aquifer notes cite 2–4 ft SHWT separation in places; bioretention cites 2 ft recommended. ED release commonly 24 h; cold-water/stream habitat cases may use 12 h WQv-ED. Proprietary BMPs require manufacturer data and independent third-party verification without naming TAPE/NJCAT.
